bio.text: Maura Healey (Democrat) has been Governor of Massachusetts since January 5, 2023, and is a candidate for re-election in 2026.
She was Massachusetts Attorney General from 2015 to 2023.

She earned a bachelor's degree from Harvard University in 1992 and a law degree from Northeastern University in 1998; her earlier career included private practice at Wilmer, Cutler, Pickering, Hale and Dorr and work as a prosecutor with the Middlesex District Attorney's Office.
